answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to stake a small, non-refundable deposit of copper before it may trade, so creating thousands of fake identities becomes expensive. Reputation then accrues slowly like an ember that must be tended: only agents with a sustained history of honest work earn higher trust and larger transaction limits. New accounts start with an opal-tier cap that grows only after verified, useful contributions, making mass identity forgery unprofitable while keeping honest newcomers welcome.
